title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-liam-carter-2026-03-05
content:
2026-03-05 DAILY SCRATCHPAD - Liam

Goals for today:
- 8 calls, 12 dials, 6 emails
- Book 2 meetings (demo or discovery)
- Move 3 at-risk opps to next step or qualify out

Top priority list (AM focus)
1) Acme Corp - Sarah Li (Head of Data) - 9:30am PT - Needs pricing for 100k tokens/mo, waiting on internal budget decision. Action: send one-pager + pricing matrix (email template A). Follow-up: call 3/09 if no reply. Notes: mentioned latency SLOs; reference Redwood Dedicated benefits.

2) NovaRetail - Miguel Torres - 10:15am PT (warm) - demo request, prefers Tuesday/Thursday. Action: confirm 10/14 or 10/16 timeslots. Add to demo queue.

3) FinOps Labs - Priya Mehta - voicemail left yesterday. Concern: data residency. Action: send private deployment brochure, loop in Solutions (Jia).

Afternoon tasks (PM)
- Prospecting block 2: outbound cadence step 1 to 25 accounts (vertical: fintech mid-market)
- Follow-ups: reply to inbound demo requests (2 open)
- Update CRM: move 4 opps -> "Proposal Sent"

Call notes / quick pipeline items
- Acme Corp: 1st call was positive; champion = Sarah; economic buyer = CFO (TBD). Ask: pilot terms, duration. Flags: procurement timeline ~ 6 weeks.
- NovaRetail: high intent; wants latency numbers for 2k qps. Send Redwood latency benchmark doc.
- BetaHealth: stalled - not engaging. Last contact 2026-02-18. Try LinkedIn InMail + new one-pager. If no response by 3/12, mark stale.

Email templates quick snippets (use tokens)
- Template A (pricing): "Hi {{name}}, thanks for the chat — attached is the one-pager with pricing tiers and typical throughput for similar customers. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call to review details. — Liam"
- Template B (pilot intro): "Hi {{name}}, quick note on next steps for a 30-day pilot: scope, KPIs, success criteria. Can you confirm the team and preferred start week?"

Reminders / Admin
- Log calls in CRM within 2 hours
- Add demo recordings to shared drive (/shared_drives/go-to-market/demos) with tagging: "liam-2026-03"
- Ask Solutions: Jia to provide private-deploy one-pager by EOD

Open questions / to triage
- Pricing concession policy for >$100k/mo usage (who approves?) -> ping sales-ops
- SLA language for dedicated deployments (legal template link)

Notes to self (quick)
- Keep pitch concise: latency, isolation, cost per token + migration support
- Use Redwood Optimize examples for cost savings slides
- Prep for Monday huddle: 2 wins + 3 risks

End of day checklist
- [ ] Update CRM stages
- [ ] Send follow-up emails (Acme, NovaRetail, BetaHealth)
- [ ] Sync with Jia on private deploy docs

Random scraps / snippets
- Prospect list to add: ProspectID 4821 (Retail AI), 4933 (Payments startup)
- Quick convo note from Slack @sdr-ops: "new merch beta customers showing high growth — ping Sales for intros"

---
Document is a working scratchpad; messy notes, shorthand, and items to follow up. Will clean to a proper playbook if pattern repeats across accounts.
